thread:
alex: Quick sync — PM requested a dashboard showing cache effectiveness across tenants: KV cache hit rate, evictions, and prefix reuse by workload. Need runtime + infra telemetry inputs. Who can own metric schema?

maria: I can drive schema. Do we want tenant-level, model-level, and workload tags?

alex: tenant + workload are must-haves. model as optional. Also want seq_len bucket for perf correlation.

devon: runtime can emit counts: kvcache.request_total, kvcache.hit_total, kvcache.eviction_total, prefix_cache.reuse_total. All should be labelable by tenant_id, workload, model_name, seq_len_bucket.

sara: can infra add an ingestion-friendly tag: region and instance_pool? helps routing policy analysis.

maria: yes include region. Also propose normalization: expose hit_rate as a derived metric in dashboard (hit_total/request_total) and reuse_ratio for prefix.

chris: UX question — should dashboard be per-tenant default or aggregated by workload? ops wants aggregated with tenant filter. product wants per-tenant template for support.

alex: do both. default view aggregated; showing top 10 tenants by request volume and a dropdown to isolate tenant.

devon: implementation note: runtime ships per-request metric with a tiny payload. Example instrument: 
```
kvcache.request_total{tenant="t-123",workload="chat",model="redwood-3",seq_len_bucket="1-128",region="us-west1"} 1
kvcache.hit_total{...} 1
```

maria: can we add an enum label cache_outcome={hit,miss,evicted,prefetch_hit} instead of separate counters? simplifies cardinality but might be less straightforward to roll up.

sara: watch cardinality. tenant_id + workload + model + seq_len_bucket + cache_outcome + region could explode. Suggest we keep counters and provide a single outcome label only for low-cardinality workloads (internal only).

alex: good call. default: counters + labels (tenant, workload, model, seq_len_bucket, region). optional outcome label behind feature flag.

chris: dashboard panels requested: 1) cluster-level hit rate over time, 2) eviction rate per-tenant, 3) reuse_by_workload heatmap, 4) top regressed prompts (linked to evals).

maria: I'll draft a PromQL spec for metrics and a Grafana dashboard JSON. Devon, can runtime start emitting names above within 2 sprints?

devon: yes 2 sprints workable. I'll open PR for metric names + proto example. Also need a cheap KV tag on spans: `cache.hit=true` for tracing.

alex: ownership: Maria = schema + dashboard JSON, Devon = runtime instrumentation PR, Sara = ingestion/quota impacts, Chris = UX filters and tenant templates. I'll create a kanban ticket and link the PRs.

telemetry-bot: New ticket created: INF-8421 "Cache effectiveness dashboard: schema + runtime metrics" assigned to maria. Link: https://go/repo/INF-8421

maria: I'll post the PromQL proposal in #eng-platform/docs and open a dashboard draft next week. Anyone else want edit access?

chris: add me and product-buddy. Also we need a small rollout plan: emit metrics behind a feature flag, validate ingest cost for top 50 tenants, then enable globally.

alex: +1. Add checklist item: quota bump request for prometheus/metrics-ingest if 95th percentile traffic increases. Sara can prep estimate.

sara: will run an ingest cost simulation once we have expected cardinality from devon.

maria: ok I'll include cardinality guidance in the spec. Draft coming ~Mon.

alex: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the ticket and assign. :thumbsup:
